_comment: Camera URLs for the live path (WP6-T3, WP7-T2). Copy to `cameras.json` and fill in.
`configs/cameras.json` is gitignored, and deliberately: an RTSP URL usually carries the
credentials for a camera that watches identifiable people, and a committed one is a
credential leak that outlives the commit. This example exists so the shape is obvious
without anyone having to read `scheduler.live_sources` to find it out.
Keys are venue id -> camera id -> URL. The camera ids must match the ones in
`slots_schedule.json` for the same venue: `live_sources` refuses a slot whose cameras it
has no URL for, because a silently dropped camera is half a pitch reported as the whole
Run it with `uv run python -m pitch_occupancy.worker --source live`, which asks for
confirmation first and refuses to save evidence images unless told to. Nothing else in
this project has ever opened a real camera stream - see the ladder in docs/runbook.md for
what is and is not enforced when one stops responding.
